public_rationale: The full antecedent and causal chain are not established. [Census research](https://www.census.gov/library/working-papers/2026/adrm/CES-WP-26-25.html) documents uneven adoption, but does not establish an adoption-failure-driven market reversal. [Amazon's workforce announcement](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/company-news/amazon-workforce-reduction) documents cuts with a different stated explanation. Counting technology layoffs without proving the specified mechanism would not fairly test this forecast.
limitations: U.S. survey findings do not establish global failure of core-business adoption.
Company explanations of layoffs may be incomplete, but that does not justify substituting an unproved cause.
The cited survey period ends in January 2026 and does not settle subsequent adoption.
The open deadline prevents treating an incomplete layoff count as a failed forecast.

statement.excerpt: If businesses don't adopt AI at scale — not experimentally, but at the core of their operations — the revenue is simply not there to sustain the hype, and once the market turns, it will turn hard, demanding efficiency and cutbacks that will lead to tens of thousands of job cuts.

not experimentally, but at the core of their operations

our_interpretation: The antecedent requires inadequate adoption in core business operations and a resulting market reversal against the AI infrastructure investment thesis.
I interpret 'tens of thousands' as at least 20,000 aggregate eliminated jobs across the affected AI and cloud industry.

The predicted cuts must follow investor pressure caused by inadequate adoption and revenue. Layoffs caused by successful automation, ordinary restructuring, or unrelated business weakness do not qualify.
The revenue language supplies the mechanism; it is not a specified monetary amount for a named company.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes failed core-business adoption at scale, a resulting revenue-driven market reversal, and at least 20,000 job eliminations attributable to the ensuing efficiency demands.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent occurs, a completed and clearly bounded retrenchment episode produces fewer than 20,000 attributable job eliminations. Without a completed episode or deadline, a low interim count cannot falsify the forecast.

evidence.explanation: Amazon announced approximately 14,000 corporate-role reductions but attributed the changes to organizational simplification and resource allocation while describing strong business performance.
